documents.title: OAuth2 Bearer Token Lifecycle
documents.content: OAuth2 bearer tokens authenticate stateless microservice requests. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes, requiring clients to execute a refresh token grant against the identity provider.

documents.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pooling
documents.content: PostgreSQL connection pooling via PgBouncer optimizes database resource consumption. Max client connections are capped at 500, with transaction-level pooling reducing backend overhead.

documents.title: Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler
documents.content: The Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) continuously queries Prometheus CPU and memory utilization metrics to scale replica pods dynamically between 2 and 10 instances.

documents.title: Zero Trust Network Architecture
documents.content: Zero Trust network architecture mandates mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication and microsegmentation across all internal services, assuming perimeter network compromise.
